full_page.content:
c. 1949
The following is a faithful transcription of the typed original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus, C. F.M. Cap.
(to M. Krausman)
Saint Felix Friary Huntington, Indiana
Praised be Jesus Christ! - and Mary our blessed Mother whom He has given us poor sinners to be our advocate and our heavenly Queen.
Many thanks for your kind favor of the 5th, just noted. I noted the enrollments as requested - also the special holy Mass in honor of the Holy Ghost for your guidance and that of your friends. ..... Why should we worry? Why not rather ponder on the wonderful and innumerable manifestations whereby God in wis- dom and power and mercy has brought us into existence and thus far preserved us - notwithstanding our waywardness, our stupidity and our sinfulness. Is not His solicitude for our happiness - even temporal as well as eternal more manifest at every turn than that of all most loving parents and other friends? 0 if we would but keep in mind at all times the sweet words of our dear Lord - at once a philophic admonition and a paternally loving invitation - "Seek ye, therefore, first the Kingdom of God .... " Patience therefore, "God condescends to use our powers, if we don't spoil His plans by ours."
from S. E. Corner
Fr. Solanus O.F.M.Cap.
